messages:
ana: Quick vendor sync — partners are asking for a joint announce window for H200 + MI300 in mid-May. Need embargo windows, SI slotting, and driver/image readiness. Who can confirm timelines?

tom: Pinging NVIDIA contacts now. Early H200 samples target week of Apr 20; they flagged a firmware tweak that could push certification. Tentative embargo: May 10–12, but i'll confirm.

ravi: AMD MI300 update: image regression + perf CI finishing Apr 28–30. Marketplace tagging can start May 1. We should aim to freeze SKUs by May 3.

sophia: Habana/Gaudi supply still constrained — recommendation: stagger SI rollouts and announce Gaudi in a separate wave (late-May) unless we get lab surge.

jen: From marketplace ops: we need final SKU list + manifests by May 3, release assets by May 8 to hit a May 12 public PR. Also require cert matrix (OS/kernel/drivers).

ana: (typo) — ignore

tom: Suggest a fallback plan: if H200 firmware blocks us, fallback to H100-optimized SKU + quantization guidance in the release notes. Add that to the press runbook.

ana: (removing my typo message)

ana: Re: embargo windows — can we set a hard cut-off of May 12 for final sign-off? Engineering needs 48h to vet PR artifacts. If vendors need earlier visibility, we can do an embargoed partner briefing May 9.

ravi: Driver/kernel note: SI images mostly validated on kernel 6.1. Some customers run 6.5 kernels. Need to confirm driver builds on 6.5 by Apr 26; adding eng-infra for kernel CI.

sophia: Lab availability: I reserved May 2–4 for high-priority MI300 perf runs; second block May 12–14 for full SI soak. If we want Gaudi earlier, we need to swap and book additional capacity.

jen: Ops checklist (quick):
```
- SKU list (by May 3)
- Release manifest (by May 8)
- Partner embargo briefing (May 9)
- Final eng sign-off (May 11)
- Public PR (May 12)
```

ana: Good checklist. Can someone own the firmware/driver gate and the fallback plan?

tom: I'll own NVIDIA firmware gate. Will escalate if samples slip past Apr 25.

ravi: I'll handle MI300 driver validation and confirm kernel 6.5 CI.

sophia: I'll coordinate lab bookings and SI partner slots.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Vendor Roadmap Handshake — mid-May announce window" • Guests: ana, tom, ravi, sophia, jen • Meeting: 60m • Link: <https://calendar.internal/event/abc123>

ana: Thanks all. Action items: tom confirm H200 embargo by Apr 22; ravi confirm kernel 6.5 validation by Apr 26; jen finalize SKU template by May 1; sophia lock lab slots. If any vendor asks to move earlier, call out supply risks and fallback SKU language. :white_check_mark:
